name: Should I choose luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or laminate for my rental property?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or laminate for my rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both LVP and laminate are popular for rentals, but they have key differences. LVP is 100% waterproof, making it ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and areas prone to spills. It's also generally more durable against impacts. Laminate offers excellent scratch resistance and is often more budget-friendly upfront. However, laminate is not waterproof and can swell if exposed to significant moisture. Consider your budget, the specific room's use, and desired longevity when making your choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: LVP is waterproof and more impact-resistant, suitable for all areas. Laminate is scratch-resistant and more budget-friendly but not waterproof. Choose based on budget, room use, and durability needs.
